tasks.name: Wikipedia biography
tasks.instruction: Find Ada Lovelace on Wikipedia. Report her full birth date, birthplace and mother’s name. Cite the biography page and a short supporting quote.

tasks.name: arXiv paper lookup
tasks.instruction: Find the paper titled exactly “Attention Is All You Need” on arXiv. Report its arXiv identifier, first two authors and original submission date. Cite the abstract page and a short supporting quote.

tasks.name: GitHub issue lookup
tasks.instruction: Find issue #1 in microsoft/TypeScript on GitHub. Report its title, whether it is open or closed, and the username of the person who opened it. Cite the issue page and a short supporting quote.

tasks.name: PyPI package metadata
tasks.instruction: On PyPI, inspect the httpx project and its release history. Report the latest stable release version and its minimum required Python version. Cite the project page and a short supporting quote.

tasks.name: Python documentation
tasks.instruction: Find the Python documentation for json.loads. Report the exception raised for invalid JSON and the supported types of its input argument s. Cite the relevant documentation page and a short supporting quote.

tasks.name: GOV.UK holiday calendar

zen.description: Dispatch synthetic keydown/keyup on the focused control, including chords such as Control+A. For JavaScript keyboard handlers only: native editing, focus navigation, shortcuts and form submission defaults are not emulated. Use fill or submit for those operations.
zen.name: callisto_press

zen.description: List frames in the controlled tab. Frame access depends on granted website permissions.
zen.name: callisto_frames

zen.description: Select a frame by frame_id from callisto_frames, inject the bridge and return a fresh snapshot. Navigation resets selection. Cross-origin frame input fails closed because parent hit testing cannot be verified.
zen.name: callisto_frame

zen.description: Manage the user's browser after they grant Enable browser access in the extension. background start/pause/resume/stop controls only the already shared tab and needs the optional tabs grant; the user must prepare the window in the extension first because Firefox/Zen may focus it on creation. Execution then preserves the tab and login in an unfocused agent window. View is a user control. Other actions support tabs, screenshots, cookies, bookmarks, history and downloads. tab_select activates and shares that existing tab; tab_activate only focuses it, including browser-protected pages. tab_create accepts an HTTP(S) url and window_id; omitting url creates about:blank. Use tab_navigate with tab_id and an HTTP(S) url to load a blank tab before page actions. In opt-in Full browser control mode, new tabs/windows are automatically shared and page tools can adopt the active tab or reactivate their selected tab. Full mode can only be enabled in the extension UI; Stop turns it off. Check callisto_status.fullAccess. Browser restrictions still apply. window_close closes the specified whole window, including its tabs; use the id returned by window_create for agent-window cleanup. Cookie values are sensitive. Downloads prompt for a save location. Zen may omit inactive workspaces.

agent_container.description: Create a new tab or window in the opt-in isolated Callisto cookie container; existing logins will not be available there.

operation.description: Required for background. The agent window must remain unfocused and unminimized; unsupported conditions pause instead of raising it.

zen.name: callisto_browser

zen.description: Additional DOM operations on the active controlled page. scroll uses viewport pixel deltas; hover dispatches synthetic pointer/mouse events; select chooses an option by value; check sets a checkbox; text returns bounded visible body text; find searches visible body text. Input uses the explicitly selected callisto_input mode.
zen.name: callisto_page

zen.description: Search visible page text and return bounded matching snippets. Unlike Chromium accessibility search, this uses rendered DOM text.
zen.name: callisto_find

zen.description: Submit the form associated with a snapshot ref, preserving browser validation and submit handlers. Use an input or submit-button ref. Submission may navigate; the next snapshot waits for the page.
zen.name: callisto_submit

zen.description: Execute 1–10 dependent actions in the controlled tab and return a final snapshot in one tool call. Batches stop if tab ownership changes. Earlier actions are not rolled back on failure. Ten-second deadline; input uses the explicitly selected callisto_input mode.
zen.name: callisto_batch

zen.description: Read structured rows from the shared page using CSS selectors: a row selector plus a field map. Optionally follow a next-page control and merge pages. Returns typed rows, not a snapshot, so counting and aggregation need one call.
zen.name: callisto_extract

zen.description: Run 1–40 dependent steps in one call: navigate; click/fill/submit/select/check/hover by ref or exact role; press; scroll; wait; wait_for text or CSS selector state; extract rows. Use submit instead of synthetic Enter for forms. Returns the last extraction and an optional final snapshot. Stops at the first failure within a 60-second budget; earlier steps are not rolled back. Input uses the explicitly selected callisto_input mode.
zen.name: callisto_run

zen.description: Inspect the selected tab. In Full browser control mode, the active tab is adopted automatically when none is selected; otherwise share a tab or call callisto_browser tab_select first. Use max_chars to bound output and offset=next_offset to page through truncated controls. Refs belong to the latest snapshot. This experimental DOM-derived snapshot can omit content and frames.
zen.name: callisto_snapshot

zen.description: Navigate the shared active tab to an HTTP(S) URL. Requires the user to grant optional access to all websites and re-share the tab. Poll callisto_status until ready, then take a fresh snapshot.
zen.name: callisto_navigate

zen.description: Click a ref from the latest snapshot in the shared tab using a synthetic DOM click. Some websites reject synthetic input.
zen.name: callisto_click

zen.description: Fill a ref from the latest snapshot in the shared tab using synthetic input events. Some websites reject synthetic input.
zen.name: callisto_fill

browse.name: execute
browse.description: Execute Playwright JavaScript against the browse session. Code runs in a restricted JavaScript realm on the relay without process, require, import(), fs, child_process, http/https or Node fetch; save and read files with the files helper inside the execute file roots, and cookie access is limited to the session's pages. Synchronous code stops after about 2 seconds. It is not a security boundary, so treat code as running as the user. The result includes console logs, warnings, a bounded execution-context diagnostic when relevant, and an aftermath summary (URL movement, navigations, error counts, handoffs, and a bot challenge or block page when one appears: hand interactive ones to the user with handoff(), never solve or retry-loop them).

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. It receives browser, context, page, state, modules (path, url, util, crypto, buffer, zlib, events, stream), files (dir and roots properties; path(name), write(target, data), read(target, encoding?)), fillInput, fillInputs, snapshot(options?) for compact semantic outlines (options: find to search them, diff or delta for changes), persistent compatible ref(id) locators, webmcp (list/call), screenshotWithLabels(options?) and screenshotDiff(options) for screenshots, ariaSnapshot, ghostCursor, handoff, demonstrate, network (start/status/stop/cancel), pageConsole (start/stop capturing the page's own console messages and errors, off by default because pages can detect it), and secrets.type(locator, name) to type a stored site secret (see secrets_list) only on its allowed origins, without seeing it. There is no location, document or fetch global (they belong to the page: use page.url() or page.evaluate(...)), and no structuredClone.

session.description: Optional existing browse session id. Explicit ids must already exist; omit this field to use your current session (each agent has its own), which is created when needed.

targetUrl.description: Optional URL substring selecting an existing attached page. This does not navigate or open a URL; use page.goto() for that.

targetIndex.description: Optional zero-based attached page index selector.

browser.description: Optional browser id for a new session's tabs; omit for the default browser. A session stays in its browser. Call status to list the connected browsers.

timeoutMs.description: Optional overall script timeout in milliseconds (paused while handoff() waits on the user); defaults to 60000, 0 disables.

cost_note: Actual CLI usage is retained. Signed-in subscription does not provide per-trial dollar charges.
measurement: Fresh host conversation per run. Host elapsed includes startup, model turns, navigation, waits, failures and retries. Task elapsed additionally includes independent answer/evidence validation. Profile setup and neutral-tab reacquisition are separate. Verification is not cut off the timer. Browser output UTF-8 bytes and characters are separate from model input/output/cached tokens.
scope: Six public informational workflows, two repetitions. Anonymous owned browser profiles; initially the first round is cold per site and the second is warm. A resumed phase resets profiles and is explicitly identified in phase metadata. Fixed gold facts for stable pages; time-stamped official JSON/API oracles for mutable metadata. Native task-tool catalogs differ and are saved. Not a store-install, authenticated-account or production reliability test.
